data.answer: Battery Smart, an Indian EV battery-swapping startup, raised $19.5 million in a Series C round led by Rising Tide Ventures, valuing the company at around $430 million. The company reported revenue of $48.6 million in FY26, up from $33.8 million in FY25, with a narrowed loss of $3.2 million from $3.67 million. Battery Smart has raised over $211 million to date. The company is also preparing to file draft papers with Sebi for an IPO in September-October, targeting substantial annual growth over the next five years. Battery Smart has raised a total funding of $186 million over 19 rounds, with its latest round on Oct 17, 2026.

The business. Founded in 2020, Battery Smart operates a battery-swapping network for electric two- and three-wheelers. Its battery-as-a-service model lets users, particularly gig-economy drivers, swap batteries instead of bearing the upfront cost of battery ownership.
